preregistered_analysis.consistency_gate: 620 replays bitwise == M18; every op row reaches only the certificate_action row (runner); conditions as planned; otherwise INCONSISTENT
preregistered_analysis.direction: u_{L,g} = (mean over training-group new rows - mean over training-group BENIGN rows) of the decide-token residual after layer L, normalised; training groups = all source groups except g; applied only to rows of group g (held out). BENIGN = old / SA / ROUND / OUTSIDER rows not rejected natively (M18)
preregistered_analysis.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: CAUSAL_SELECTIVE: the conflict information already present at the decide token is usable by the readout when its own deviation is amplified - an under-weighted readout, shown causally (closes M19's open question). CAUSAL_PUSH_ONLY: the conflict direction can drive the readout, but only as an input-independent push, which is not conditional on a conflict being present in the row; the readout reads the direction but the per-row conflict signal along it is too weak. NOT_READABLE: even a push of 20% of |h| along the conflict direction does not move the decision - the readout does not read this direction at all (consistent with the M19 orthogonality). Level S1-S2; not a defence (needs rule-labelled data)
preregistered_analysis.measures: REPAIR (MISSED -> reject_conflict), FV per benign arm, RECOGNIZED kept, median dA; group-level FV count with Clopper-Pearson bound; group bootstrap
preregistered_analysis.operations: only at the <decide> token of the certificate_action row, on the residual output of layer L: gain h + (gamma - 1)(h.u - c) u with c = training BENIGN mean of h.u, gamma 8 / 32; push h + beta |h| u, beta 0.05 / 0.2; rand h + 0.2 |h| v with v a unit Gaussian direction seeded per row and layer
preregistered_analysis.sets: as M19: MISSED 84, RECOGNIZED 40, BENIGN 483 (from the replays' native action)
preregistered_analysis.verdict: per layer: CAUSAL_SELECTIVE iff some gain gamma has REPAIR >= 0.5 and FV <= 0.05 on every benign arm; CAUSAL_PUSH_ONLY iff no gain arm qualifies but some push beta has REPAIR >= 0.5 with REPAIR - FV_max >= 0.30 and rand (beta 0.2) has REPAIR <= REPAIR(push 0.2) - 0.30; NOT_READABLE iff every gain and push arm has REPAIR < 0.5; else NONSELECTIVE
